aiVerification.summary: Draft captures repair-check outcomes but invents an unsupported baseline comparison and includes invalid/partial metric grouping.
issues: No explicit normal or baseline condition is evidenced.
Changed-factor domain and label are overbroad and include unsupported Total condition.
Header-derived measurement outcomes are not valid evidence metrics.
Outcome rows are incomplete and totals are inconsistently mixed with daily rows.
Evidence includes context/header rows that do not support condition comparison.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this be treated as post-repair validation with no baseline comparison?
correctionPlan: Relabel changed factor as Repair Frame+Coil post-repair check process only.
Remove baseline/normal wording and unsupported domains unless separately evidenced.
Keep dates and lot dates as subgroup keys for row-level results.
Remove header-only measurement outcomes and use inspection result tables only.
Include all valid populated rows or separate daily rows from total summaries consistently.
